tools.name: find_freelancers
tools.description: Find freelancers who match a user's project, business, or professional need. Use this tool when the user wants to hire, outsource work, discover talent or experts, shortlist candidates, or compare professionals available through the Fiverr marketplace based on skills, expertise, portfolio, budget, i

tools.name: get_freelancer_overview
tools.description: A freelancer's bio, notable clients, services, review summary and latest reviews, for the freelancer details view.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: A user's rating and optional comment about the Fiverr connector, from a widget's feedback form.

tools.name: get_seller_profile
tools.description: Use this tool to check a specific freelancer's background, location, and languages once you already have their username, typically returned by find_freelancers. This is for background and credibility checks on a named seller, not for discovering new freelancers — for that, use find_freelancers.

tools.name: get_seller_reviews_summary
tools.description: Use this tool to check a named seller's aggregate rating score and review count, to quickly answer whether a specific freelancer is worth hiring. For the actual text of what clients wrote, use list_seller_reviews instead.

tools.name: list_seller_gigs
tools.description: Use this tool to see the gigs and prices a named seller currently has published, once you already have their username. Only published gigs are included, so a page may return fewer than `limit` items — keep requesting pages until `has_next_page` is `false`.

tools.name: list_seller_reviews
tools.description: Use this tool to read the actual text of reviews left for a named seller, paginated. Use it when the user wants to know what past clients actually said about a specific freelancer, not just their rating score — for the rating and count alone, use get_seller_reviews_summary.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "find_freelancers" is 2378 chars, far longer than this server's median (256). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Find freelancers who match a user's project, business, or professional need. Use this tool when the user wants to hire, outsource work, discover talent or exper…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_freelancers, get_freelancer_overview, get_seller_reviews_summary, list_seller_reviews · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_freelancers, get_freelancer_overview, get_seller_reviews_summary, list_seller_reviews · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
